## Recognition & milestones {#recognition}

The people and collaborations behind our research have earned fellowships, awards and academic milestones. Here are a few of their stories.


::: {.achievement-grid}
::: {.achievement-card}
::: {.eyebrow}
2025 · Scientific recognition
:::
### Rector’s Awards for BioGenies

[Michał Burdukiewicz](team/mb.qmd) and [Jarosław Chilimoniuk](team/jc.qmd) received First Degree Rector’s Awards for publications; [Valentín Iglesias](team/vi.qmd) received a Second Degree award. Michał was also recognised for his SONATA grant.

[Read the Rector’s Awards story →](posts/2025_12_16_rector_awards.qmd)
:::

::: {.achievement-card}
::: {.eyebrow}
2025 · European fellowship
:::
### An ERA Fellowship for Jarek

[Jarosław Chilimoniuk](team/jc.qmd) received a Horizon Europe ERA Talents Postdoctoral Fellowship to investigate small molecules and amyloid polymorphism at Vilnius University.

[Explore the fellowship and research plans →](posts/2025_05_19_jarek_fellowship.qmd)
:::

::: {.achievement-card}
::: {.eyebrow}
2024 · Scientific recognition
:::
### Recognising research publications

[Michał Burdukiewicz](team/mb.qmd) received the First Degree Award from the Rector of the Medical University of Białystok for his publications from 2023.

[Read about Michał’s award →](posts/2024_12_06_rector_award.qmd)
:::

::: {.achievement-card}
::: {.eyebrow}
2025 · Our wider research community

### Ronja’s Women’s Advancement Award

[Ronja Tittel](colab/rt.qmd), who completed a research placement with BioGenies, was honoured at BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg for her work.

[Discover Ronja’s achievement →](posts/2025_07_02_ronja_award.qmd)
